title.zh-TW: Windows 狀態列不再永遠空白
title.en: Windows status line no longer stays blank forever

body.zh-TW: Windows 電腦沒裝 Python 時，Claude Code 面板不會再永遠只顯示「--」。安裝程式原本只看 PATH（告訴電腦去哪找程式的搜尋名單）裡有沒有 `python` 或 `py`，卻沒確認它能不能跑；Windows 10、11 內建的 App Execution Alias 只是引你去 Microsoft Store 安裝的假 `python.exe`，也會被誤認。於是 statusLine hook（顯示在終端機最底下狀態列的掛鉤小程式）每次更新都靜悄悄失敗，`usage-status.json` 沒寫出來，面板便一直空白。現在安裝程式會先用 `--version` 實測候選程式，不能執行就跳過。像插座看似有孔、裡頭卻沒接電；現在會先試亮測電筆，才把線接上。
body.en: On a Windows PC without Python, the Claude Code panel will no longer show `--` forever. The installer used to trust any `python` or `py` found on PATH (the list of places Windows searches for programs) without checking whether it could run. Windows 10 and 11 ship an App Execution Alias: a placeholder `python.exe` that only sends you to Microsoft Store, yet it was mistaken for Python. The statusLine hook, a small program that updates the bottom status line, then failed silently on every refresh, so `usage-status.json` was never written. Now each candidate must pass `--version` first. It is like testing an outlet before plugging in the appliance.

items.original: **Claude Code panel no longer stays blank forever on Windows**: the installer picked whichever `python`/`py` `shutil.which()` found on `PATH` without checking it actually ran, so on any Windows machine without a real Python install, it silently wired the statusLine hook to Windows' non-functional "App Execution Alias" stub (the placeholder `python.exe`/`python3.exe` that Windows 10/11 ships by default to prompt a Microsoft Store install). The hook then failed silently on every refresh, `usage-status.json` was never written, and the Claude Code panel showed `--` permanently — not a first-run loading state. The installer now actually runs each candidate with `--version` before trusting it, and skips any that don't execute.
